cohort: 142 women with twin pregnancies who delivered at Municipal General Hospital and Medical College, Ahmedabad over a 2-year period.
finding: Twin pregnancies were associated with a high rate of preterm birth (83.8%), anemia (41.5%), low birth weight (91.9% <2.5kg), and perinatal mortality (11%).
mod_finding: Vaginal birth occurred in 44.5% of twin deliveries, while 55.6% underwent cesarean section.
